text:
Maria (Sales): Hey team — ACME Health wants to spin up a POC next week. Procurement is asking for MSA + DPA signed before they start. They also want an explicit signer delegation (they say procurement can sign on behalf of legal). They redlined the DPA: changed SLA 4.2 from 99.9 -> 99.95 and added SLA credit table. Also pricing ask: dedicated GPUs for POC, NET30 billing, separate usage invoice. Need confirm on signer exception + pricing. cc @Alex H @Tara (Legal)
Alex H: Noted. Who's the procurement lead and do we have the redlines?
Maria (Sales): Contact is j.green@acmehealth.com. Uploaded their redline: https://drive.company/acme/acme-dpa-redline.pdf 
Samir - Platform: For dedicated POC: baseline pricing is $1200/day per A100-equivalent. We can offer POC promo credit for first 30 days. Need model + expected qps to size.
Tara (Legal): I'll take the redline. Quick Q: are they insisting on EU-only data residency and customer-managed KMS?
Maria (Sales): Yes — EU region only + KMS in their tenant, plus audit logs retention 12 months.
Ops Bot: Uploaded order form template v3.2 to /company-drive/purchase-templates/orderform-v3.2.pdf 
Alex H: On signer delegation — we can accept a "designated signer" but legal needs a delegated authority clause and a named contact. Tara, can you draft a short clause that limits scope?
Tara (Legal): I can. We won't accept an open delegation. Draft clause will: 1) require named procurement contacts, 2) cap delegated signature authority at $100k, 3) require ratification by an exec for larger amounts. Is $100k a hard cap?
Maria (Sales): POC will be < $25k. But if they convert to committed capacity it could exceed $100k. They want a blanket delegation if possible.
Samir - Platform: Implementation note: if they require tenant KMS + VPC peering for POC, we need their KMS admin contact and VPN details. Typical onboarding is ~5 business days after we get credentials.
Alex H: Ops experience suggests a temporary hosted KMS for the POC to avoid delays, then migrate to tenant-managed KMS pre-prod. Recommend we offer that as an option and record migration steps in SOW.
Maria (Sales): Customer insists tenant KMS from day 1. Any fatal blockers?
Samir - Platform: Not fatal, but we need their security ops to provide the KMS ARN, SSH jump host, and peering CIDR. If they can provide immediately, we can hit their timeline.
Jules (Finance): 40% discount on dedicated rate for pilot is pretty deep. We can approve 30% pilot discount and invoice as a non-recurring credit; 40% requires leadership sign-off.
Maria (Sales): Tagging @Jules (Finance) — understood. I'll present 30% and note finance wants credits tracked.
Tara (Legal): My early take on redlines: accept EU residency + audit logs. Counter the 99.95 SLA — we can commit to 99.9 across shared/hosted models; for dedicated infra we can discuss 99.95 with stricter monitoring and higher credits. Propose SLA credit cap = 30 days' fees. Will add an "Authorized Signer" clause limited to named procurement contacts and require exec ratification for >$100k. I'll post a draft response by EOD.
Alex H: Sounds good. Action items: 
- Tara: draft clause + redline response (EOD)
- Samir: estimate onboarding time for tenant KMS + list required artifacts (2d)
- Jules: confirm discount workflow and invoice note (today)
- Maria: send customer the offer with 30% pilot discount, temporary hosted-KMS fallback, and expected onboarding timeline.
Maria (Sales): Thanks all — will consolidate and share back. If Tara posts the draft I'll route it to ACME procurement directly. :thumbsup:
